verdict.rationale: The evidence describes the Voice Agent as a Deepgram-hosted WebSocket API reached through Deepgram-run regional endpoints (EU, AU, India). Nothing shows an open-source or self-hostable agent runtime. The GitHub starter apps are client templates that call the hosted API, and Pipecat/LiveKit are third-party frameworks that only consume Deepgram STT/TTS, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
